2608.27449.title: SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance
2608.27449.paper_summary: To improve large language models' ability to resolve real-world software issues, prior work has focused on constructing large-scale agent trajectory datasets and performing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on successful trajectories. However, task success does not guarantee high-quality supervision: successful trajectories may still contain ineffective, redundant, or risky steps. Directly using such trajectories for SFT can introduce noisy supervision and encourage models to imitate undesirable problem-solving behaviors. Therefore, we propose SWE-Prime, a multi-granularity, two-stage SFT data selection method that progressively filters training data at the trajectory and segment levels. Specifically, the first stage performs trajectory-level screening based on process quality, result quality, and data representativeness, selecting a high-quality and representative subset of successful trajectories. The second stage performs segment-level selection by grouping consecutive steps into semantic segments and assessing each segment based on its contribution to the final solution, learnability, and potential risks. During SFT, all segments remain in the sequence to preserve context, while only selected segments contribute to the loss computation. Experiments on SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified show that training on the 10% trajectory subset selected by SWE-Prime outperforms training on the full resolved dataset, yielding relative performance gains of up to 12.2% and 24.2%, respectively.
2608.27449.paper_summary_zh: 為了提高大型語言模型解決現實世界軟體問題的能力，先前的研究專注於構建大規模代理軌跡數據集並對成功的軌跡進行監督微調（SFT）。然而，任務成功並不保證高質量的監督：成功的軌跡可能仍然包含無效、冗餘或有風險的步驟。直接使用這些軌跡進行SFT可能會引入噪聲監督，並促使模型模仿不良的問題解決行為。因此，我們提出了SWE-Prime，一種多粒度、兩階段的SFT數據選擇方法，逐步過濾軌跡和片段層級的訓練數據。具體而言，第一階段根據過程質量、結果質量和數據代表性進行軌跡層級篩選，選擇出一個高質量且具有代表性的成功軌跡子集。第二階段通過將連續步驟分組為語義片段並根據其對最終解決方案的貢獻、可學習性和潛在風險來評估每個片段，進行片段層級選擇。在SFT過程中，所有片段保持在序列中以保留上下文，而只有選定的片段對損失計算有貢獻。在SWE-Bench Pro和SWE-Bench Verified上的實驗顯示，基於SWE-Prime選擇的10%軌跡子集的訓練表現優於對完整解決數據集的訓練，分別實現了高達12.2%和24.2%的相對性能增益。
